Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.
The screw pump type is self priming positive displacement pump 
and is used for 
delivery of lubricating fluids. veyor elements are three spindles, each with a 
double pitch or circulating the lubricating oil two separate filling oil pump 
sets are provided one pump is driven by an AC motor during normal operation 
conditions. The second pump is equipped with DC motor for standby.
Safety Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued.
The 
 qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc.
The pump is out of service.
The motor is disconnected from the control 
 panel.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 tool set includes manual wrenches ... etc.
Some mechanical spare parts 
 (mechanical seal bearing ... etc).
During pushing on of the mechanical 
 seal assembly sleeve.
Tighten hexagonal screws with 
 a torque wrench.
Blanco 1 ton.
Work to be Carried Out
Every 500 working hours
Check pump sound.

Disassemble the pump.
Check all internal parts for wear.
